notes.title: Virtual Arctic Expedition available again!
notes.notes:
Following a transfer of the rights of Virtual Arctic Expedition, the application is now available again on Steam!

Good news come in pairs: the price of the application has been decreased to $2.99!

notes.title: Green Hill Studio shutting down
notes.notes:
Sad news... Green Hill Studio is about to shut down, therefore Virtual Arctic Expedition will no longer be available for purchase on Steam starting November 6, 2019.

Anyway, we thank you for your support!

Have fun underwater!
The Green Hill Studio crew.

notes.title: Back to school offer
notes.notes:
Virtual Arctic Expedition special discount: [b][u]60% off[/u][/b] to mark the occasion of the return from the summer holidays! Get your biology degree thanks to this wonderful scuba diving in the Arctic Ocean seabed!

Take advantage of this offer until the 14th of September 2019!
